# x402 Text Structurer

> Convert free-form text into structured key-value pairs + entities. Lightweight and deterministic-first for reliable agent pipelines.

## Free Discovery
GET /catalog

## Paid
POST /api/structure
Body: { "text": "..." }

Returns keyValues object + entities (emails, urls, phones, dates, money amounts).

Price ~0.015 USDC. Standard x402 flow.
